title: Production voxel first-run checks
manual_graphics_note: Validate production assets and configuration before starting the Vulkan window.

steps.title: Validate portable persistence
steps.goal: Confirm the reference save and asset manifest remain exact and loadable.
steps.command: cargo run -p alife_tools --bin p34_persistence -- validate-save crates/alife_world/tests/fixtures/p34/tiny_save.json crates/alife_world/tests/fixtures/p34
steps.expected_signal: the save, config, and asset manifest validate

steps.title: Validate production assets
steps.goal: Reject missing, unlicensed, or placeholder production assets before launch.
steps.expected_signal: the FVR07 production asset receipt reports zero rejected assets

steps.title: Validate the production launch
steps.goal: Resolve the production profile, save, GPU policy, and voxel asset roots without opening a window.
steps.expected_signal: the production voxel launch summary reports the selected profile
